_comment: Documented divergences of the Go engine against the event_stream corpus. Fail-closed: a failing case NOT listed here is red; a listed case that starts reproducing the reference verdict is red (stale baseline); a listed case that never ran is red. The three sus-patterns registry events (pattern_detected/added/removed) left this registry when the runtime registry landed (guardcore/suspatterns_registry.go); the remaining three cases are host error-text renderings and the harness URL artifact.

cases.event_stream/evt_geo_lookup_failed_downl: the download-failure reason renders the Go error type ('*url.Error') where the reference pins the python exception class name ('RuntimeError'); the envelope is otherwise identical
cases.event_stream/evt_https_enforced_redirect: the harness pins url_replace_scheme to the scheme-swapped origin without the path (pipeline_harness._PipelineRequest.url_replace_scheme); the Go engine mirrors the real adapters and renders the full request URL (https://example.com/api)
cases.event_stream/evt_redis_error_connection_: the envelope matches except the reason column, which quotes the redis-py exception rendering; the Go client renders its own dial error text
